# pixel-builder

> Pixelizer for AI agents: turns a realistic image into TRUE pixel art (one solid colour per pixel) at 8/16/32/64-bit era limits. MCP server and CLI.

## Run
- MCP stdio: `npx tsx src/agent/cli.ts mcp`
- MCP HTTP: `npx tsx src/agent/cli.ts mcp --http --port 8788` -> http://127.0.0.1:8788/mcp
- CLI: `npx tsx src/agent/cli.ts <tool> [args] --json`

## Tools
- `pixelize` image (path|url) [mode scene|sprite|tile] [era 8|16|32|64] [preset] [bloom] [dither] [outline] [size] [seed] [out_dir]: writes native PNG, upscaled preview PNG, meta JSON; returns paths and the preview image.
- `validate` path [max_colours] [scale]: alpha 0/255, colour limit, uniform scale x scale blocks.
